Revision: 396
Author: al...@bedatadriven.com
Date: Mon Nov 21 06:58:27 2011
Log: Removed the EvalResult class. All evaluate() and apply() methods
now return a SEXP, and REPL visibility is controlled by a Context-wide flag.
Results in a ~10% speed up of the mean.var.online benchmark.

In principle, it's very clean to R expressions evaluate to a tuple of
(result, visible), but in practice it results in the creation of 10s
of millions of little EvalResult wrappers, and generates a lot of ugly
java code wrapping and unwrapping SEXPs.


http://code.google.com/p/renjin/source/detail?r=396
